title: Customer Operations Coordinator
description:
Customer Operations Coordinator

Location: Bournemouth
Salary: 28,000 to 31,000 per annum
Job Type: Full Time Permanent

About the Role

TeamJobs are recruiting for a Customer Service Executive to join a well established and growing business based in Bournemouth.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys delivering exceptional customer service in a fast paced environment. You'll be responsible for supporting customers throughout their journey, managing enquiries, coordinating appointments and working closely with internal teams to ensure a seamless customer experience.

Benefits
- 28,000 to 31,000 per annum
- 33 days annual leave including Bank Holidays
- Company pension
- Company sick pay
- Career development and progression opportunities
- Employee referral programme
- Performance related salary reviews
- Company events and team socials
- Free flu jabs
- Eye care vouchers
- Monday to Friday working
- Modern office environment

The Role

As a Customer Service Executive, you will be the main point of contact for customers, ensuring they receive a first class service from enquiry through to resolution. You'll liaise with customers, engineers and internal teams to coordinate appointments, resolve issues and keep customers informed every step of the way.

- A proactive approach to problem solving.
- The ability to remain calm and professional in a busy environment.
- A positive, team focused attitude.
- Good IT skills, including Microsoft Office, and confidence using CRM systems.

Apply Today

If you're looking to join a growing business where you can develop your career and make a real difference to the customer experience, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today or contact TeamJobs for more information.

title: Operations Assistant
description:
Service Operations Coordinator - EV Infrastructure

Location: Bournemouth Airport
Job Type: Full-time, Temporary on going (opportunity to go permanent)

Pay: 13.96
Working Hours: 8.5-hour shifts between 7:00am and 6:00pm, including a 1-hour unpaid lunch break

TeamJobs are recruiting for a Service Operations Coordinator to join a busy and growing team supporting Electric Vehicle Infrastructure (EVI) customers.

This is a varied coordination and administration role, where you will be responsible for managing faults and incidents, coordinating engineer attendance and ensuring customers are kept up to date throughout the process.

The role:
- Coordinating and managing EV infrastructure faults and incidents
- Dispatching and scheduling Field Service Engineers
- Prioritising engineer workloads and responding to urgent faults
- Keeping internal systems updated with the latest fault information
- Chasing engineers for updates and attendance details
- Communicating with customers and providing progress updates
- Working to agreed Service Level Agreements
- Monitoring fault management systems and interfaces
- Supporting the implementation of new EV infrastructure customers and processes
- Attending customer meetings where required
- Maintaining up-to-date contract and customer documentation
- Escalating issues where necessary and taking ownership of incidents through to completion

What we are looking for:
- Previous administration, coordination or customer service experience
- Excellent communication and organisational skills
- Strong attention to detail
- Ability to work well under pressure in a fast-paced environment
- Good IT skills, including Microsoft Outlook, Word and Excel
- A proactive and positive approach to problem-solving
- Ability to build strong relationships with colleagues, engineers and customers
- Confidence working independently and managing tasks through to completion

Experience within EV infrastructure or a technical environment would be beneficial, but is not essential.

Location and hybrid working

The role will initially be based in Poole, before relocating to the Bournemouth Airport area from October 2026.

For the first six months, the role will be fully office-based whilst training is completed. Following successful completion of training, there will be the opportunity to work on a hybrid basis, with three shifts per week based in the office.

Please note: Due to the shift times and future location, candidates must be able to reliably travel to the Bournemouth Airport site without relying on public transport.

If you are an organised and proactive coordinator looking for a varied role within the growing electric vehicle infrastructure sector, we would love to hear from you!

title: Workflow Administrator
description: Shore Medical is seeking a Workflow Administrator to join our supportive team at Poole Road Medical Centre, working across the Shore Medical group. The role involves processing clinical correspondence, accurately updating patient records, identifying required actions and ensuring information is appropriately coded. You will work closely with GPs and the wider clinical team to support efficient workflows, maintain accurate patient records and reduce the administrative burden on clinicians. Job Type: Permanent, Part-time Hours: Wednesday 8.00 - 14.00, Thursday and Friday 8.00 - 18.00 Process incoming clinical correspondence across all Shore Medical practices. Accurately code diagnoses, procedures and investigations and update patient records. Identify any required follow-up actions and ensure these are directed to the appropriate team. Liaise with GPs, clinical staff and the Pharmacy team regarding clinical correspondence and medication reconciliation. Identify complex or high-risk correspondence requiring clinical input and escalate appropriately. Respond to queries relating to processed correspondence and investigate any identified incidents. Support the development of efficient workflows and improvements to administrative processes. Ensure patient records are accurate, up to date and consistently maintained. Process correspondence (paper, electronic, email) that is received across all practices within Shore Medical. Accurately code diagnoses, procedures and investigations, following the Shore Medical Workflow protocols. Liaise with the Pharmacy team to facilitate timely and accurate medications reconciliation, following agreed protocols. Identify and record key clinical data such as new diagnoses, BP recordings, smoking status, and other items as detailed in the Workflow guide. Identify any actions, such as blood tests to be arranged, and task the relevant group. Identify the complex or high-risk areas that require input or knowledge from the clinical team, including safeguarding issues, working to the agreed protocols. Liaise with clinical staff for complex correspondence. Responding promptly to any queries about letters processed by Workflow. Investigate incidents promptly and identify where changes need to be made to ensure prevention of future incidents. Help develop new ways of processing incoming paperwork and correspondence, including coding. Undertake additional tasks as required by the line manager or GP Partners.
